mechanism: If the {{agent}} detects it is looping or repeating text, it deliberately injects high-temperature {{noise}} or a random oblique {{strategy}} {{card}} into its {{context}} to force a trajectory change.
failure_modes: Derailment into nonsense: the injection is large enough that the {{signal}} does not return.
False positive: legitimate repetition is read as a loop, and a working trajectory is perturbed.
invariants: Fires on a detected loop or repetition, not as a standing perturbation.
Injects at most `temperature` worth of {{noise}}, leaving the {{signal}} recoverable.
Returns to a coherent trajectory after the injection.

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.description: Magnitude of the injected noise, as a share of full randomness.

parameters.name: detection_threshold
parameters.description: Similarity between successive outputs that counts as looping.

parameters.name: cooldown
parameters.description: Minimum interval between injections, so noise does not become the trajectory.
